tools.name: get_highlight_names

tools.name: show_highlight
tools.description: Highlights a toolbar icon or UI element. Use when user asks to be shown something.

params.name: item
params.desc: The specific UI element to highlight. CRITICAL: This MUST be an exact string returned by the 'get_highlight_names' tool. DO NOT guess or substitute. If the user's requested element (e.g., 'browser') is not in the returned list, you MUST NOT substitute it with a workaround like 'Add channel'. You must leave this tool uncalled and tell the user you cannot highlight that specific item.

params.name: tutorialName
params.desc: A short label/identifier for the tutorial step (e.g., 'Open Piano Roll'). This is shown internally and used for grouping. ALWAYS provide a value.

params.name: tutorialCaption
params.desc: The instructional text displayed to the user along with the highlight.Keep this very brief. Never say 'click here' as the user will need to click a Continue button to remove this message.
